name: Kikugawa (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kikugawa city emblem in green: a stylised chrysanthemum leaf in two shades of green.
history: Municipal flag of Kikugawa, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 17 April 2005.

features.role: Kikugawa city emblem — a stylised chrysanthemum leaf in two shades of green
